info.bio:
Captain & Tennille es un grupo de música pop formado por Daryl Dragon (nacido el 27 de agosto de 1942) y Toni Tennille (nacida el 8 de mayo de 1940). Ellos se casaron el 11 de noviembre de 1975.

scenes.name: El disco
scenes.book: Funk: The Music, the People, and the Rhythm of the One
scenes.author: Rickey Vincent
scenes.desc: Una simulación repetitiva de la crudeza del funk negro, alargada por máquinas y no por músicos que improvisan. Nació en clubes europeos de finales de los sesenta que pinchaban funk original, llegó a Estados Unidos y en 1974 era la moda de la Costa Este: aceleró la destrucción de la sesión en directo, de las bandas y de la grabación con alma, y la música negra se volvió más mecánica y menos significativa. El disco quería bailar sin fin sobre un ritmo único; el funk, levantarse y hacer jam («Freak of the Week»: nada de ese «disco sádico» de un solo golpe). Las bandas de funk lo atacaron («The Undisco Kidd», «Anti-Disco» de Mutiny) o se vendieron: James Brown se proclamó «Original Disco Man», los Ohio Players, los Isley y Earth, Wind & Fire («Boogie Wonderland») cayeron. El grito «Disco sucks» metió en el mismo saco a toda la música negra de baile, y muchas bandas de funk murieron por no vender como el disco.

xref.title: A&M Records Contract Termination and Payout (March 16, 1977)
xref.body: Six days after signing with A&M Records and trashing their London offices, the Sex Pistols were dropped by the label on March 16, 1977, partly due to objections from other A&M acts like Captain & Tennille. Manager Malcolm McLaren was informed the decision was for "humane reasons." Although the band did not receive the full 150,000 pounds from their contract, they were paid 75,000 pounds, a significant sum for less than a week's work. "The pistols didn't collect their 150,000 pounds, but they did walk away with 75,000 pounds."

xref.title: Dennis Dragon's Musical Family Background
xref.body: The Surf Punks were formed by Dennis Dragon, who came from a highly musical family. His father was a symphony conductor, and his brother is Darrell Dragon, known as the Captain in Captain & Tennille. "The surf punks were formed by Dennis Dragon, a guy from a very musical family. His father was a symphony conductor, but if that wasn't weird enough, his brother is Darrell Dragon, the captain in the captain in Teneal."
